answer_4.quote: Four trained annotators (see Section 4.2) annotated MRBench using the validated taxonomy.
answer_4.guideline: The taxonomy with eight dimensions: mistake identification, mistake location, revealing of the answer, providing guidance, actionability, coherence, tutor tone, and human-likeness.
